answer: Since the throttle counters live in the terrace ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 229 keys thus pays for 229 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the shale quota and the mirror admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
